parts.text: $PRMB: operating profit outpaced sales growth in Q3 — revenue +3% to $1.8B, operating margin 13.7%. 👇 #earnings #beverages
$SPG: sold more but kept less in Q3 2026 (preliminary) — revenue +13% to $1.8B, but net earnings fell to $499M. 👇 #earnings #REITs
$GNW: revenue growth slowed to −7% as Q3 sales dipped to $1.8B, with an operating margin of −0.1%. 👇 #earnings #insurance

$INGR: sold slightly less but profit took a steeper hit — revenue $1.8B (−1% Y/Y), operating margin 11.2%. Q3 results weighed down by higher input costs and Argo recovery delays. (preliminary) 👇 #earnings #consumer
$TEAM: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $469M, 516% of net earnings. Q1 FY27 (preliminary) revenue $1.8B (+24% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #software
$WYNN: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $97M vs net earnings $17M. Q3 revenue $1.7B (−8% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #consumer
$MCHP: profit grew faster than sales — Q2 revenue reached $1.6B (+42% Y/Y) with a 28.6% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #semiconductors
$SARO: operating profit grew faster than sales in Q3 (preliminary) — revenue +4% to $1.6B, operating margin 10.3%. 👇 #earnings #aerospace
$JHX: profit is growing faster than sales — revenue +24% to $1.4B, with an operating margin of 18.4%. 👇 #earnings #materials
$EPAM: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $289M, 222% of net earnings. Q3 revenue $1.4B (+2% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #software
$AGNT: revenue grew 6% to $1.4B, but costs outpaced sales and the quarter ended with a net loss of $4M. 👇 #earnings #realestate
$G: advanced tech solutions drove all growth in Q3 (preliminary), jumping 30% Y/Y while total revenue reached $1.4B (+7%). 👇 #earnings #industrials
